{{Intro/Quest|The Commander of Time}}

==Summary==
As the dust settles, Jué meets with you as promised. You learn that you were once Jué's master and established Jinzhou with its assistance. Jué notices something usual about your Tacet Mark just as Abby appears and the two confront each other. Even Jué is uncertain of Abby's origins, but suggests that you visit the Black Shores, the starting point of your journey in this world.

The flow of time has returned to normal. Mt. Firmament thrives once more, and you journey to Hongzhen to meet with [[Changli]] and [[Xinyi]]. All is not what it seems, however. The Fractsidus is planning its next move...

==Steps==
# Leave [[Mianloong Chamber]]
# Confront the Sentinel "Jué"
# Leave the [[Temporal Loop]]

==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(When player leaves the area)
;(Cutscene starts)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_390_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_390_1_F.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' {{MC|m=Lord|f=Lady}} Arbiter, one is curious about your choice this time.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_390_2.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Wherever the tides may take us, you will bear witness to our fight.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_390_3.ogg}} '''Xinyi:''' Government must be guided by virtue. Hsi, do you keep this in mind?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_390_4.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Yes, virtue must come first. Politics, commerce—it all must serve the people.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_390_5.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' From now on, you shall be known as "Jinhsi," bearing [[Jinzhou]]'s name as your own.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_390_6.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' What do you think of this world?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_390_7.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Like... here. Darkness clings, but lights flicker in the gloom... 
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_390_8.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' A guiding light is not easily lit.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_390_9.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' That's why they stand out so brightly against the darkness.
;(Cutscene ends)
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_1.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' This entrance leads to one's [[Sonoro Sphere]]. Magistrate Jinhsi, one shall await you there.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_2.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' {{Rover}}, this battle is related to the fate of Jinzhou, and only you can open this Sonoro Sphere. The key to Jinzhou's future lies in your hands.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_3_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_3_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' ...If I open it, Jinhsi is bound to face you in the ultimate battle.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_18_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_18_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' The ideal outcome would be for her to absorb your power at the critical moment and restore the time flow without any loss of life.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_19_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_19_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' But there's also a chance that she could push herself too far and end up dying from Overclocking.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_4_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_4_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Though... if I do nothing, you'll use your remaining power to freeze all of Jinzhou in time.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_5.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Correct.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_6.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Now, please let us know your choice.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_7.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' {{Rover}}...
:{{DIcon}} I will open the entrance once you're ready.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_10.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I have been preparing for this moment.
:{{DIcon}} There will be no turning back...
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_11.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I understand. I have made up my mind since before I stepped foot on Mt. Firmament.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_12.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Leaving Jinzhou behind fills me with regret, knowing I may never again bask in its glorious sunshine or witness the purity of its snowflakes.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_13.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' But that's why I'm here—to ensure that others can still experience the wonders of nature.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_14.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' Our city has a rich history, with generations witnessing endless sunrises and sunsets at the border. Our people have sacrificed their blood and tears to protect Huanglong's safety.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_15.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' They deserve a bright future.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_16.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I want to protect Jinzhou in my own way, as Jinhsi, as a citizen of Jinzhou, and as Jinzhou's Magistrate.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_395_17.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' {{Rover}}, let's begin.
----
;(Cutscene plays)
;(Cutscene ends)
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_398_1.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Quite the impressive feat, Magistrate Jinhsi.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_398_2.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' However, you are still a long way from inheriting my power.        
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_398_3.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Back down now while you still can.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_398_4.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' I have made up my mind, and I will not back down.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_398_5.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' You once said it's not easy to become a candle of light...        
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_398_6.ogg}} '''Jinhsi:''' But I still want to try. I want to see if I can ignite a spark of hope for Jinzhou!
----
;(Cutscene plays)
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_400_1_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_400_1_F.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' {{MC|m=Lord|f=Lady}} Arbiter, may this one transfer the Temporal Mandate to Jinhsi?     
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_400_2.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' This one has heard your decision.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_400_4.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' The transfer has been carried out as you instructed.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_400_6.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Jinhsi, one shall honor one's promise and restore Jinzhou's future to you and its people.
;(Cutscene ends)
----
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_1.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Jinhsi has recovered. One will soon send her back to Jinzhou for recuperation. Please do not worry.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_2.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' With all matters resolved, as per the agreement, it is time for one to address you.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_3.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
:{{DIcon}} (Ask about your past.)
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_9.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' I am Jué the Sentinel, the guide of Jinzhou's civilization. Everything about Jinzhou has been stored in my mind.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_10.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' You, {{Rover}}, are my Arbiter, and my former master.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_11.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' In bygone days, I stood by your side as you established the Jinzhou city. You tasked me with safeguarding its prosperity. 
::{{DIcon}} So why did I lose my memories?
::{{DIcon}} Who am I?
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_14.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' This one begs your pardon, for it is not all-knowing. All my knowledge came from you.
::{{DIcon|Return}} '''"Jué":''' One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
:{{DIcon}} (Ask about the "choice" and the "access".) 
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_15.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' In the past, one was granted the key to that Sonoro Sphere by your hand.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_16.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' You said you planned to participate in history, to make choices and witness the development of civilizations.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_17.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' One had previously requested for permission to transfer the Temporal Mandate to Jinhsi, as that is how one is designed to function.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_18.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Every ounce of my existence, from life to death and even the passing on of power, is subject to your approval.
::{{DIcon|Return}} '''"Jué":''' One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
:{{DIcon}} (Ask about Jinhsi's condition.)
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_19.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Since Jinhsi has inherited my power, the Temporal Programs are now complete. Jinzhou is no longer under threat.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_20.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Jinhsi has fully assumed the mantle of leadership. From this day forth, one shall only offer aid when it is truly needed. 
::{{DIcon}} Why didn't you tell Jinhsi about it eariler? 
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_22.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' This situation has been analyzed before, but the number of variables made reaching a safe conclusion impossible.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_23.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' To accomplish her goal, Jinhsi must possess both strength and confidence. Revealing the truth to her earlier would only add to her troubles and not aid in improving her abilities.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_24.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Today was not the ideal moment for our destined battle to unfold, but the Fractsidus has remarkably escalated its arrival.
::{{DIcon|Return}} '''"Jué":''' One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
:{{DIcon}} (Ask about the current situation in Hongzhen.)
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_25.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' The flow of time on Mt. Firmament has been restored to its natural pace, but the citizens of Hongzhen must still contend with shortened lifespans should they attempt to depart.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_26.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Fortunately, with Jinhsi's Resonance Ability, they can stay safe as long as they remain on the mountain.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_27.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' For lack of a better solution, this is the best we can do.
::{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_28.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Through countless ages, the imposing Mt. Firmament stood firm against the storms. But as spring brings thunder and change, one feels a spark of transformation in the air.
::{{DIcon|Return}} '''"Jué":''' One is prepared to answer any inquiries you may have.
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} I have no other questions.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_29.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' The people of Hongzhen have a bright future ahead, one that can be steered in the right direction within mere days. With proper leadership.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_50.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Your [[Tacet Mark]]... There is something unusual.
:{{DIcon}} You mean Abby?
:{{DIcon}} Abby, wake up. Someone's asking about you.   
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_32.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Whoa... What... What's wrong?!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_33.ogg}} '''Abby:''' {{Rover}}, who's bullying you?!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_34.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Is it you, big thing?! Huh?! How dare you, I'm gonna teach you a le...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_35.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Hmm? Wait, pause... I don't think it has any bad intentions... It smells like the "unnatural" smell I smelled in Jinzhou before...
:{{DIcon}} Well, about the Sentinel I was looking for...
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_37.ogg}} '''Abby:''' Ooh, so you must be that Sentinel! Hehe, hello there big one!      
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_38.ogg}} '''Abby:''' {{Rover}}, why didn't you wake me up earlier? I've got a feeling I missed out on a lot of fun!
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_39.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' ...It does feel similar to me, but there is some difference.      
:{{DIcon}} Do you know what it is?
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_41.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' ...This entity is unfamiliar to me. As it resides within your Tacet Mark, one can only assume you granted it access intentionally.
:{{DIcon}} Then who else can answer my questions?       
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_43_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_43_F.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' {{MC|m=Lord|f=Lady}} Arbiter, have you heard of the [[Black Shores]]?
:{{DIcon}} The Black Shores? I've heard of them.        
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, I know those people.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_46.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' The Black Shores is the starting point of your journey in this world. If you have doubts, this one suggests a visit to that island.
:{{DIcon}} I'll keep it in mind.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_48.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' Worry not.
:{{A|Vo mtfrmmq 1_1_405_49.ogg}} '''"Jué":''' The wuthering waves ebb and flow. They shall send you back to where you belong.
{{Dialogue End}}
